quotes.text: When speaking about the blessings pertaining to the gospel, and the consequences connected with disobedience to its requirements, we are frequently asked the question, what has become of our fathers ? will they all be damned for not obeying the gospel, when they never heard it ? Certainly not. But they will possess the same privilege that we here enjoy, through the medium of the everlasting…
